correctness.rationale: Replacing a complex vector by its entrywise absolute values simultaneously bounds both shift correlations by the corresponding nonnegative real quadratic forms. Re(J_n^2) splits into parity path blocks. For n even their equal Perron eigenvalues allow a unit top-eigenvector with strictly positive Re(J_n) cross term, proving finite-t strictness. For n odd the simple top eigenvector and positive gap gamma give beta-b>=gamma||y||^2 and a<=3||C||||y||, yielding finite tau=sup a/sqrt(beta^2-b^2). For n=3 a reflection-symmetric vector reduces R^2 to max_{0<=s<=1/2} [4s+(t^2-8)s^2]. For n=5 independently verified the claimed polynomial Q=k(r^2-2)^2/2+B(r)u^2+k u^4 and exact discriminant factorization in Q(sqrt 2); sign analysis and top-two-block perturbations give tau_5^2=k. Sine Perron overlap tends to 1 and beta-eta~pi^2/m^3, proving stated bounds of order n^(3/2), not an exact limit constant. Finite regressions are only checks.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroborative and do not replace the all-parameter mathematical proof.
